title: Kurzweil scorecard: source verification and reconciliation supplement
review_disclosure: AI-assisted source review and editorial assessments; not human peer review. Original book editions were not independently collated. Author retrospectives are distinguished from contemporary publications and independent outcome evidence.
scope: 50 curated forecast/version records plus a disposition for every one of the 88 imported leads. Not a lifetime census and not a representative statistical sample. Related unlocated versions are quarantined rather than silently replaced.
